questions.def: Slept is the past tense of 'sleep,' which is an intransitive verb.
questions.question: The baby ___ all night.

questions.def: 'Wrote' is the past tense of 'write,' a transitive verb needing an object.
questions.question: She ___ a letter to her friend.

questions.def: 'Rang' is the past tense of 'ring,' an intransitive verb here.
questions.question: The phone ___ loudly.

questions.def: 'Shone' is the past tense of 'shine' when used intransitively.
questions.question: The sun ___ brightly this morning.

questions.def: 'Put' is transitive; it takes a direct object (the book).
questions.question: He ___ the book on the table.

questions.def: 'Raised' needs an object. Correct: 'She raised her hand'.
questions.question: She raised her hand to ask a question.

questions.def: 'Rises' is the correct present tense of 'rise,' an intransitive verb.
questions.question: The sun ___ in the east.

questions.def: 'Rose' is the past tense of 'rise,' used intransitively here.
questions.question: The price of gas ___ again.

questions.def: 'Kept' is transitive; it takes a direct object (the money).
questions.question: He ___ the money in his pocket.

questions.def: 'Fall' is intransitive; it doesn't take a direct object.
questions.question: Leaves ___ from the trees in autumn.

questions.def: 'Fell' is the past tense of 'fall,' an intransitive verb.
questions.question: The vase ___ from the table.

questions.def: 'Laid' is the past tense of 'lay,' a transitive verb (object = keys).
questions.question: She ___ her keys on the counter.

questions.def: 'Lay' is the past tense of 'lie,' an intransitive verb.
questions.question: He ___ on the beach all day.

questions.def: 'Flows' is intransitive; it describes the river's action itself.
questions.question: The river ___ to the sea.

questions.def: 'Raised' (transitive) needs an object: the flag.
questions.question: They ___ the flag in front of the building.

questions.def: 'Walks' is intransitive; she is performing the action herself.
questions.question: She ___ to work every morning.

questions.def: 'Barked' is the past tense of 'bark,' an intransitive verb.
questions.question: The dog ___ loudly.

questions.def: 'Held' is transitive, it takes a direct object (the door).
questions.question: He ___ the door open.

questions.def: 'Sat' is the past tense of 'sit,' an intransitive verb.
questions.question: He ___ in the chair.

questions.def: 'Stopped' is the past tense of 'stop,' used intransitively here.
questions.question: The engine ___.

questions.def: 'Set' is transitive; it takes a direct object (the table).
questions.question: She ___ the table for dinner.

questions.def: 'Begins' is intransitive; it describes the movie's action.
questions.question: The movie ___ at 7 PM.

questions.def: 'Began' is the past tense of 'begin,' an intransitive verb.
questions.question: The meeting ___ late.

questions.def: 'Passed' is transitive; it takes a direct object (the ball).
questions.question: He ___ the ball to his friend.

questions.def: 'Flew' is intransitive; 'in' shows the location.
questions.question: The bird flew ___ the sky.

questions.def: 'Reads' is transitive; it needs an object ('book').
questions.question: She ___ a book every week.

questions.def: With 'He', use 'doesn't'. 'Like' needs an object (to eat meat).
questions.question: He don't like to eat meat.

questions.def: 'Sang' is the past tense of 'sing', an intransitive verb here.
questions.question: She ___ beautifully at the concert.

questions.def: 'Slept' is intransitive; use an adverb 'soundly'.
questions.question: The baby slept ___ all night.

questions.def: 'Bought' is transitive; it needs an object ('a house').
questions.question: They ___ a house last year.
